purpose gap: Tested: account with its own primary group, comment, home and shell; exactly the desktop groups with the default empty mygrouplist; the passed hash logs in via su and a wrong password is refused; the key pushed as <title>@puppet; the lock script installed and, with p8testuser logged in to Plasma, kscreenlockerrc [Daemon] Autolock/LockOnResume true, Timeout 5, LockGrace 0 (both phases agree, ALL_PASS). Left out and NOT in the outcomes table, neither mapped nor listed uncovered: the wrapper's own handling of the mygrouplist parameter (user_desktop.pp:7,9 prepends the given groups to the built list, so they become supplementary groups, and via user_base.pp:25-31 a first given group other than sudo/wheel becomes the primary group while sudo/wheel keeps the own group). That is the only logic the wrapper adds beyond passing parameters through, and production desktop users are given groups through it; the table must list it, covered by a check or as an uncovered row with evidence and lifted_by (the lab node can create such groups, so a one-fixture limit is not a lab-capability lack). Passthrough parameter variants (ignorekey, myhomemode, user_shell, ecryptfs, non-default screenlock values) are reasonably delegated to user_base's and user_kde_lock_screen's sets as the header says, but the table should say so too.
